digest.component_or_area: test infrastructure / subprocess and network reliability tests
propositions: Two test-only real-time windows (10s stall window and 1s per-attempt timeout) consume multi-second wall time per matrix cell despite contracts being about throughput/retry schedule rather than elapsed seconds.
The slow-progress remote test serves a real loopback socket for 15 seconds to verify sustained bytes above the floor survive one complete low-speed window.
The ACLI read-retry test uses real child processes and production retry schedule [2, 4] but sleeps the actual backoff durations, extending test duration unnecessarily.
Injected test-only short windows (1s) with real socket/process execution and polling-based cleanup can replace production-scale timing while preserving all contract semantics and coverage.
Production timeout, stall, grace, drain, attempt, and backoff defaults must remain unchanged.
